definitions: A city in San Bernardino County, California, United States.

blocks.text: Chino is a 1973 Spaghetti Western film directed and produced by John Sturges, written by Clair Huffaker, and starring Charles Bronson, Jill Ireland, Marcel Bozzuffi, and Vincent Van Patten. It is based on the 1967 novel The Valdez Horses by Lee Hoffman. The film was an international co-production between Italy, the United States, France, and Spain.

Chino is a Nepali action drama film written and directed by Tulsi Ghimire. The film featured an ensemble cast of Shiva Shrestha, Bhuwan K.C., Sunil Thapa, Kristi Mainali, Sharmila Malla, Subhadra Adhikari, Shravan Ghimire, Sinaura Mistry, Anoop Malla and Sushila Raymajhi. The film is a revenge story of two brothers played by( played by Shiva Shrestha and Bhuwan K.C.) who are separated after their parents were killed by a criminal Rate Kaila. How they reunite and find the reason why their parents were killed and take revenge forms the rest of the story. The film was shot entirely in Nepal.
